name: @agrune/backend
description: Shared Playwright-based browser backend for the agrune MCP server and CLI daemon.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agrune/manifest run build && pnpm --filter @agrune/core run build && tsup
scripts.pretest: pnpm --filter @agrune/manifest run build && pnpm --filter @agrune/core run build
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm run pretest && AGRUNE_BACKEND_SMOKE=1 vitest run tests/playwright-driver.spec.ts
